reviews.text: I highly recommend Omni Outdoor Oasis if you’re looking for a company to build or maintain.  We built with them a little over a year ago and have been using their services for weekly maintenance ever since. They are punctual and thorough.  Anytime I’ve ever had a question it has been promptly and professionally addressed by Lauren in their office as well as their pool technicians. We’re looking forward to another great summer of swimming!
reviews.author: Darcy Sobczak

reviews.text: We previously hired Merlux to build our pool. They scammed us and took our money without finishing the project. After a lot of searching and stressing to find another company, we found Omni. They saved us and our pool. It was hard to trust another company after what we went through, but I am glad we did. We have a beautiful pool now thanks to them. Mark is an amazing guy who took our concerns seriously and truly cared for us. I highly recommend this company and will forever be grateful and remember them every-time I use the pool.
reviews.author: Legacy Salon & Med spa

reviews.text: Great experience with the entire Omni team - from start to finish!  They communicated well with us, gave a fair price, and made sure everything we had agreed to was done!  I would recommend Omni to everyone… you will not be disappointed!
reviews.author: Kevin S Clinger

reviews.text: Outstanding company! After the freeze, we had massive equipment and pool damage.  They came out and immediately fixed it (spent an entire Sunday here!) just to make sure we were taken care of as soon as possible.  Professional and responsive.  Truly puts the customer first.  We won’t go anywhere else.
reviews.author: Lisa Bour

reviews.text: Let me just start with WOW! We broke ground on May 16, 2022 and we jumped into our stunning new swimming pool for the first time on August 17, 2022! Yes, those dates are 100% true! Every level of expectation was either met or exceeded and the quality of customer service has been second to none. Mark and his team have been such a joy to work with from design to completion and I feel that we have made friends in the process. Since our build, 2 of our neighbors who followed our experience along the way, have also started the build process with Omni Outdoor Oasis. We could not be more impressed! Trust the people, trust the process and you will be amazed at the end result! Happy Swimming people :)
reviews.author: Casey Jones

reviews.text: Ever since Omni took over cleaning my pool, it has looked fabulous. I feel like they actually care about doing a good job, which wasn't how I felt about my last company.
reviews.author: Pamela Beggs

reviews.text: After the big freeze of 2021, Omni got it handled! One week, start to finish... Plasyer, tile, leak repair and all new equipment.  Not only were they quick, the level of professionalism was stellar. The fact that that when they left everyday, our yard was clean and organized still. You sometimes could not tell they had been there. Not just professionalism from the sales and management side, but the tradesman!!. I wish they would have been around when we built our pool 16 years ago.
reviews.author: Tim Cislo

reviews.text: Amazing experience!!! Jeff from Omni Outdoor Oasis arrived on time and resolved our pump priming issue in minutes with ease. The absolute professional.  Jeff made it look easy. Strongest recommendation!
reviews.author: Carey Bergman

data.summary: The Google reviews appear authentic in content, but the perfect 5.0 score combined with a much lower Yelp rating creates suspicion. The lack of accessible Yelp review content prevents a full analysis of complaint patterns. The discrepancy suggests potential review manipulation on Google, such as selective solicitation or suppression of negative feedback.
fake_signals: Perfect 5.0 rating on Google with 15 reviews could indicate selective solicitation or suppression of negative feedback.
Lack of any negative or mixed reviews on Google is unusual for any service business.
Discrepancy between platforms is a significant red flag.
authentic_signals: Google reviews contain specific details (names like Mark and Lauren, project timelines, previous contractor scam story).
Varied writing styles and specific scenarios (post-freeze repair, rescue from another builder).
complaint_patterns: Cannot determine from provided data. Yelp rating suggests issues, but no Yelp review content was provided for analysis.
data.discrepancy_explanation: Major discrepancy between Google (5.0 with 15 reviews) and Yelp (2.8 with 41 reviews). Google reviews are uniformly positive and detailed, while Yelp's lower rating suggests a pattern of negative experiences not reflected on Google.
